title: Member Case Study Video - Tanjung Precision Works (PSG then EDG)
speaker: Managing director, Tanjung Precision Works (dramatised)
summary: Precision machining member. Was losing tenders on turnaround speed rather than quality: job scheduling ran on spreadsheets, quoting took three days, and machines sat idle through the night shift. A PSG pre-approved scheduling system came first, then a bespoke project let machines run unattended overnight. Quoting is now same day.
